tools.name: lookup_vendor
tools.description: The Xither record for one vendor. Use it when the user names a specific vendor and asks where it publishes its sub-processor list or DPA, how long its terms give to object to a new sub-processor, what it has changed, or when its models retire. Returns: where it publishes its sub-processor list and data processing agreement and when Xither last read each page (or why a page cannot be read); the notice window its agreement states for new sub-processors (quoted, with source URL and read date); its public changes to either document with permalinks; and model retirement dates it publishes for the next 365 days. One vendor per call; accepts a name, slug or domain. If the name matches several vendors it returns their slugs to call again with; if it matches none, the vendor is not in the record, which says nothing about what the vendor publishes. Use search_vendors instead when you only have part of a name, notice_windows to compare windows across vendors, and upcoming_model_retirements for retirements across vendors. Changes appear 30 days after Xither records them; subscribers get them the same morning at www.xither.com/pricing.

vendor.description: A vendor name, slug or domain, for example "HubSpot", "hubspot" or "hubspot.com".

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Find vendors in the Xither record by name, slug or domain. Returns up to 10 matches, each with its name, slug and record URL, and no record data. Pass a slug to lookup_vendor for the record.

query.description: Part of a vendor name, a slug or a domain.

tools.name: notice_windows
tools.description: Every sub-processor notice window Xither can quote: the number of days (business days where the clause says so) each vendor's own terms state for a new sub-processor, and what that number counts (basis: 'objection' = time to object once told, 'notice' = notice before the change, 'unstated' = the clause does not settle it), with the verbatim clause, its source URL and the date Xither read it. The same table as www.xither.com/notice-windows. A vendor not listed has no window Xither could quote.

tools.name: upcoming_model_retirements
tools.description: Model and API retirement dates from the retirement tables vendors publish, as Xither last read them, soonest first: model, date, the replacement the vendor names, the verbatim table row, source URL and read date. Optional vendor filter; within_days defaults to 90, maximum 365; at most 50 rows. Covers only vendors whose retirement tables Xither reads.

vendor.description: Optional vendor name, slug or domain.

within_days.description: How many days ahead to look, from today.
